entities.name: Genju
entities.description: A type of kami that inhabits Kamigawa's lands and, when awakened, animates them as monstrous creatures.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane where the Genju live.

entities.name: Genju of the Realm
entities.description: An enormous legendary kami with aspects of all land types, the spirit of the entire Kamigawa world coming to life.

entities.name: Genju of the Fields
entities.description: Slug-like kami growing out of the plains.

entities.name: Genju of the Falls
entities.description: One-eyed floating sea kami inhabiting the islands.

entities.name: Genju of the Fens
entities.description: Hulking horned kami of the swamps.

entities.name: Genju of the Cedars
entities.description: Plant-like kami rising out of forests.

relations.note: A type of kami of the land.
relations.quote: The Genju is a type of Kami that inhabits the lands of Kamigawa.
